We need DBE from molecular formula C8H15ClO3. DBE formula: DBE = C - H/2 + N/2 +1 (halogens count as H). No N. Halogen Cl counts as H, so effective H = H + halogens = 15 +1 =16. O ignored. So DBE = C - (H_eff)/2 +1 = 8 - 16/2 +1 = 8 -8 +1 =1. So integer 1.

We could retrieve formula via tool but we know. Might still call retrieve_dbe_formula for confirmation.
